sources_considered.why: Reports 2026 changes to Microsoft's performance review system. It shows some practices changed, but it cannot settle a vague causal claim.
Covers the 2013 end of stack ranking, before the post.

receipt.public_excerpt: Microsoft is retiring its internal peer feedback tool, Perspectives, as the company reshapes how employee performance is evaluated.

evidence_items.explanation: Shows Microsoft changed parts of its review process in 2026, including retiring Perspectives, one of the tools named in the post. Whether this means 'things' changed in the speaker's sense cannot be decided.

unresolved_gaps: The speaker does not define 'things' or give a timeframe, so no test can settle the claim.
The causal claim that growth keeps the culture unchanged cannot be checked against public evidence.
